messages:
maya: Nightly eval alert — onboarding candidate 'alto-v2q' (int4 mixed, per-layer scales) triggered failures across 3 suites at 00:12 UTC. Immediate triage please.

eval-bot: nightly-eval alert | model=alto-v2q | suites_failed=invoice-extract,summarization-longtail,math-fewshot | severity=high

ian: assigning owner? severity?

maya: initial severity = P2 (quality regression impacting extraction accuracy on our invoice cohort, affects Dedicated if rolled out). Not an infra outage but visible regression.

sam: I'll take ownership. First pass: are failures concentrated on quantized vs fp16 runs?

linh: quick check — compared int4 vs fp16 on 200 samples for invoice-extract. Int4 F1 dropped a lot. Cmd: `./bin/eval-suite --model alto-v2q --quant int4 --suite invoice-extract --samples 200` Output: `F1: 0.62 (fp16 0.80)`

maya: posting some representative failures — prompts shortened for slack: 
```
PROMPT: Extract invoice fields from text below
INPUT: "Invoice #3245
Line items: 3 x $12.00, 1 x $99.99
Total: $135.99"
FP16 OUTPUT: {"total":"$135.99","items":[{"qty":3,"price":"$12.00"}, ...]}
INT4 OUTPUT: "Total: 135.99" (missing currency symbol, items merged into single line, date dropped)

PROMPT: Summarize long meeting notes
INT4 OUTPUT: Truncated summary mid-sentence and invented attendee roles.
```

sam: logs show `kv_cache_miss` spikes and some `serialize_buffer` warnings around long-context requests (>1024 tokens). Might be quant runtime path falling back and losing alignment.

linh: also noticed tokenizer split increases on invoice tables when quantized — could cause alignment issues for extraction head. Example: tokenization pieces jump from avg 1.05 to 1.3 tokens per number.

ops-bot: deploy history: `quantize-profile v3` applied at 23:50 UTC using dynamic calibration (calibration samples: 10k). No other infra changes.

sam: immediate mitigation options: 1) pin Dedicated routing to fp16 model/version; 2) rollback quantize-profile v3; 3) add targeted calibration with table-heavy samples. Prefer quick pin for Dedicated canary.

maya: agree. Sam — can you create canary rollback for Dedicated and run focused evals? Also capture KV traces and tokenizer histograms.

sam: creating canary and ticket now. Starting targeted eval (2k samples invoice-extract + 1k longtail summarization). Will post results.

ian: reminder to notify partner success if this affects any onboarded customers. Tagging for visibility.

sam: REDWOOD-4312 created: "alto-v2q int4 onboarding regression — initial triage". Canary rollback to fp16 started for dedicated pool. ETA ~25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

eval-bot: targeted-eval complete | model=int4 vs fp16 | suite=invoice-extract | samples=2000 | delta F1 = -17.4 pts | int4 F1=0.61 fp16 F1=0.78

maya: confirmed. Sam — keep canary until we have KV traces + tokenizer histograms. If degradation >10% hold rollback and open postmortem.

linh: adding failing prompts to nightly sentinel and CI quantization tests. Will include table-heavy calibration set.

sam: update — KV trace attached to ticket, tokenizer histograms show token-split skew on numbers. Running targeted calibration with table-focused samples now.

maya: summary / next steps: 1) owner = sam, 2) run int4 vs fp16 targeted eval (done), 3) collect KV cache traces & tokenizer hist, 4) add failing prompts to sentinel and CI, 5) rollback canary for Dedicated if no quick calibration fix. I'll draft postmortem template and assign follow-up.

ian: thanks — please tag me on the postmortem once it's drafted.

sam: will post final status here once calibration run finishes (~30m).
